title: Profile: remove Additional Information and add Match History (last 5 days with wins/losses)

requirements.summary: Update Profile tab layout by removing the “Additional Information” card and showing separate “Leaderboard Rankings” and “Match History” sections.
acceptanceCriteria: On Profile page, the heading/title "Additional Information" and its description are no longer visible.
"Leaderboard Rankings" content (ProfileLeaderboardRanks) is still accessible on the Profile page.
"Match History" is visible as its own section on the Profile page (not a placeholder “coming soon” message).

file_operations.description: Remove the existing "Additional Information" Card (including its header/description). Render two distinct sections/cards: one titled "Leaderboard Rankings" (still using ProfileLeaderboardRanks) and one titled "Match History" that renders the real match history UI component (no placeholder text).

requirements.summary: Implement Match History UI showing a combined chronological list of the caller’s last 5 availability days with per-day wins/losses.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile > Match History shows at most 5 entries.
Entries are ordered by date with the most recent first.
Each entry shows the formatted date and explicit "Wins" and "Losses" counts for that date (English labels).
If a date has no recorded results yet, the entry still shows the date with Wins = 0 and Losses = 0 (or clearly indicates zero counts).
If the caller has no availabilities, Match History shows an English empty-state message instead of an error.

file_operations.description: Create a ProfileMatchHistory component that fetches match-history data via a React Query hook, then renders a list of up to 5 day entries. Each row should show the formatted day (reuse existing date formatting utilities) and explicit English labels "Wins" and "Losses" with counts (defaulting to 0/0 when missing). Include an English empty-state when there are no days, plus loading/error-safe rendering to avoid crashes.
Wire the new ProfileMatchHistory component into the Profile page's new "Match History" section so it is displayed as the section content.

requirements.summary: Update React Query hooks to use caller-scoped backend queries for available days and per-day win/loss logs, and integrate them into Profile Match History and Leaderboard date selector.
acceptanceCriteria: useGetCallerAvailableDays no longer calls the admin-only getAllAvailabilities flow and instead uses a caller-scoped backend query.
Leaderboard page date selector continues to work for recording wins/losses using caller-scoped available days.
Profile page Match History uses React Query-backed data fetching and renders without console errors when logged in as a normal user.

file_operations.description: Refactor useGetCallerAvailableDays to stop using getAllAvailabilities and instead fetch caller-scoped available days from the backend (reuse the existing caller-scoped method available in the typed actor). Ensure returned day IDs are sorted descending (most recent first). Add a new React Query hook (e.g., useGetCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs / useGetCallerMatchHistory) that returns per-day wins/losses for the caller and supports limiting to the most recent 5 entries for Profile Match History.

Update LeaderboardPage to continue using useGetCallerAvailableDays for the date selector (now caller-scoped). Ensure the selector still renders available days and continues to allow recording wins/losses without relying on admin-only data.

Use the new/updated React Query hook(s) from useQueries.ts to fetch caller day logs and render them (most recent first, max 5). Ensure day IDs and win/loss counts are handled safely (bigints to strings/numbers for display) and that empty-state behavior matches requirements.
